summary: Residential kerb where cars park, with apartments about 16-25 m behind.
reasons: Apartment blocks within 25 m, same side
Loading zone sign near the east end

best_section.where: Macquarie Street north kerb, west of the loading zone

drivers.seclusion: Apartment car parks and blocks 16 m or more behind the kerb; homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, so there is room beside the lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked both sides; a loading zone sign sits near the east end.

flags: Loading zone sign 8.7 m from the kerb line; keep clear of it
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, 189 m from Brisbane River
Dwellings 10-25 m away on the same side
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the eastern part; building shade from the north in the morning.
